component.name: pdvim
component.summary: Read documents from the keyboard, with vi keys

description.p: A minimal, keyboard-driven PDF reader with vi key bindings. It also reads EPUB and FB2 books, CBZ comics, XPS documents, SVG drawings and images.

ul.li: vi-style movement with counts, search, marks and a jump list
Tabs, a table of contents, and following links from the keyboard
Selecting and copying text in a visual mode like vim's
Highlighting text into the PDF, and filling in forms
Recoloring for dark backgrounds, and themes
Books laid out to fit the window, in one or two columns
The page, zoom and columns of each document remembered

screenshot.caption: The table of contents, in the Catppuccin Mocha theme
